scenes.title: Bright Classroom Tree
tips: Hang it by the classroom door
scenes.say: Give every student one leaf to fill, then hang the finished tree by the door.

scenes.title: Watercolor Autumn Tree
tips: Set it out with the snacks
Keep it as a family keepsake
scenes.say: Set it out with the snacks so guests can add a quick thank you as they mingle.

scenes.title: Harvest Trunk Base
scenes.say: Tape the bare branches to a wall on Monday and watch the leaves pile up all week.

scenes.title: 24 Autumn Leaf Cutouts
scenes.say: Pass one leaf to each guest at dinner, and the table activity becomes your decor.

scenes.title: Roots-to-Leaves Worksheet
tips: Roots for support, trunk for strengths
scenes.say: Start with the people who support you, then your strengths, then what you're thankful for.

scenes.title: Comic Pop Corner Tree
tips: Pin it to the bulletin board
Room for lots of leaf cutouts
scenes.say: Pin this bold corner tree to a bulletin board and leave the whole page open for leaves.

scenes.title: 30-Day Countdown Tree
scenes.say: Write one small thank you each day, and by the end of the month the tree is full.

tips.title: Before you print
items: Most come in color and B&W
tips.say: Use cardstock for wall displays, and grab the black and white versions to save ink.

say.title: Free printable gratitude trees to fill with thankful leaves this season.
say.hook: Grab some markers and scissors, and fill the branches with thanks.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
